title: infinite potions
description: a mod that adds potions that last infinitely
body:
Infinite Potions Mod
Overview:  
Say goodbye to reapplying effects! The Infinite Potions mod introduces a powerful new mechanic to Minecraft: potions with unlimited duration. Whether you're exploring the Nether, battling mobs, or building in peace, your favorite potion effects will never run out.

Features:

🧪 All standard potions now have infinite duration when crafted or configured.

⚙️ Configurable settings to enable/disable specific potion types.

🔄 Effects persist through death and respawn (optional toggle).

🎮 Compatible with most modpacks and potion-enhancing mods.

🛠️ Includes support for custom potion effects added by other mods.

Use Cases:

Permanent Night Vision for cave diving.

Infinite Fire Resistance for lava exploration.

Constant Speed and Jump Boost for parkour maps.

Endless Regeneration for hardcore survival.

Balance Options:

Optional crafting recipes using rare materials.

Server-side toggles for multiplayer fairness.

Configurable effect strength and exclusions.
